# Repository agent entry point

Read the repository root AGENTS.md first. It is the only source of rules.
Read system_design.md and FEATURE_LOG.md, and preserve the approved design.

Mandatory checkpoints: Section 3 (SEC-01 to SEC-52); Section 10 for new work,
with attack tests and mutation checks in Sections 7.3/7.6; Section 13 for audits;
Section 12 before calling work complete. Report executed checks and unavailable
verification. This file adds no independent rules.
